# forms only an XMEGA has on top of avr51.txt — des, eijmp and eicall, and the
# read-modify-write instructions of the "U" devices. One statement per line.

xch Z, r0
xch Z, r16
xch Z, r31
las Z, r0
las Z, r16
las Z, r31
lac Z, r0
lac Z, r16
lac Z, r31
lat Z, r0

lat Z, r31

# ---- no operands -----------------------------------------------------------
eicall
